## My request:
시각 의미 데이터와 후보 데이터에 반영해줘. 그 다음 스킬의 최신 버전을 사용하여 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 이번에 반영한 주제가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 주제에 어울리는 랜덤한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: The requester wants three independently chosen concepts that test the newly integrated idol-fiction topic and use the supplied image. This arm independently selected music-show rehearsal with OS randomness. My invented scene follows a fictional 24-year-old idol returning to her stage mark under the floor manager count-in, with two fellow performers making the coordination visible. The intended experience is poised appeal inside real collective work: her face matters, but production context should keep the image from becoming a detached beauty portrait. Reference use concerns visible face and hair appearance only. The performer age, rehearsal, crew, group, stage clothes, mark and camera are replaceable authorial staging, not requester facts. At creativity 1 local refinements may strengthen connected attention and rehearsal clarity without changing the broad direction.
subject: A fictional idol performer guided by the supplied portrait for visible face and hair appearance, with an agent-authored group and floor manager.
setting: An agent-chosen music-show rehearsal stage viewed from empty studio seating.
event: An observable working moment in idol life, independently staged as a count-in before a group rehearsal restart.
visual_priorities: The lead performer remains visually appealing and recognizable through visible face and hair cues within a full-length working scene.
The manager cue hand, lead directed attention and group floor positions connect into an intelligible rehearsal coordination.
Microphone, coordinated performance wardrobe and floor marks support idol-industry working life rather than a generic portrait.
All consequential hands, microphone contact, support feet and stage-edge relationships remain legible in one coherent view.
baseline_prompt_en: Create a documentary performance photograph, a photographic scene from an idol-industry story centered on a fictional idol performer during a visible working moment in idol life. Use the supplied portrait to guide the lead woman's visible facial and hair appearance: a soft oval facial outline, dark eyes, a small nose, softly defined lips, and a chin-length dark bob with wispy separated fringe. Her fictional age is twenty-four. She is on a music-show rehearsal stage just as the floor manager gives her group the count to begin again. The lead has returned to a small taped X on the dark stage floor. Her right hand holds a wireless microphone a few centimeters from her open mouth; her left arm hangs relaxed beside her hip. Her weight rests on the foot centered over the X, with the other heel lightly lifted behind. Her face turns toward the floor manager's raised hand, intent and newly ready, a slight half-smile at one corner of her lips. At the lower right edge of the stage, the floor manager in black rehearsal clothes and a headset faces the performers in three-quarter back view, raising one index finger in a clear count-in. His arm and hand stand apart from the lead's silhouette. Two fellow women in their twenties, wearing related silver-grey cropped stage jackets and dark pleated performance skirts, wait on their own separate floor marks behind the lead in a shallow diagonal formation. The lead wears the same tailored jacket with a pale satin top, skirt and practical ankle boots; a small in-ear monitor sits at her visible ear. White rehearsal work lights reveal the floor marks and the real working space beneath dim violet stage lights. Frame the lead full length at roughly two-thirds of the image height, her face remaining crisp, with the manager's cue hand and both group members visibly connected through their directed attention. A moderate wide lens from the side of the empty studio seating keeps the lead dominant while allowing the stage edge and the preparation to read. Natural skin texture, a trace of exertion at her temple and the relaxed fall of the jacket give her poised presence a quiet, close human appeal.
